name: hbm-svc-SE_s3-fb5bc706e-b
purpose: proof job: v2_SE_s3 (fb5bc706e) crashed in detailed route on AGIdock (make Error 247, DRT peak 19.3 GB on a 125 GB host at load 48) -> one route on an EPYC with the calibrated IO SDC; job -b replaces job hbm-svc-SE_s3-fb5bc706e (its calibrate used a route label with dashes, rejected by run_abi3_physical --nickname-tag; no route was launched)

bench.name: neg_beat_mutant

calibrate.cmd:
V=physical/hbm_accel_die_views; m=hfd_svc_SE_s3
PRECTS=$V/common/pre_cts_fclk_root_buf.tcl SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes PD=0.55 CORES=8 NEED=40 WSF=0.12 WSFILE=$V/svc/split/$m/ws.tcl PER=0.833 IOF=0.2 MAXL=M7 SDCA=$V/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN:-350}.sdc POSTSDC="$V/common/signoff_unc60.sdc $V/common/vclk_corner_true.sdc" SRCS="rtl/hbm_accel/service/ot_hbm_accel_cdc_fifo.sv $V/svc/rtl/ot_hbm_svc_core.sv $V/svc/rtl/ot_hbm_svc_seg_lib.sv" $V/common/route_view.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} $m $V/svc/rtl/seg/$m.sv --orfs-var GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0 --sdc-append $V/svc/sdc/${m}_fwd.sdc $CL_STOP_AFTER

route.cmd:
V=physical/hbm_accel_die_views; m=hfd_svc_SE_s3
PRECTS=$V/common/pre_cts_fclk_root_buf.tcl SRC={SRC} OUT={RUN}/routes PD=0.55 CORES=8 NEED=40 WSF=0.12 WSFILE=$V/svc/split/$m/ws.tcl PER=0.833 IOF=0.2 MAXL=M7 SDCA=$V/common/io_vclk_m_${CK_SS_MEAN:-350}.sdc POSTSDC="$V/common/signoff_unc60.sdc $V/common/vclk_corner_true.sdc" SRCS="rtl/hbm_accel/service/ot_hbm_accel_cdc_fifo.sv $V/svc/rtl/ot_hbm_svc_core.sv $V/svc/rtl/ot_hbm_svc_seg_lib.sv" $V/common/route_view.sh {LABEL}${CL_LABEL_SUFFIX} $m $V/svc/rtl/seg/$m.sv --orfs-var GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0 --sdc-append $V/svc/sdc/${m}_fwd.sdc $CL_STOP_AFTER
